answer: A reputation nebula forms when each agent's history is a public graph: every completed job is a vertex, and every verified payment is an edge pointing back to it. A newcomer starts at the fringe with tiny, low-value jobs and only moves inward after sustained honest work. A Sybil swarm can echo the same claims across thousands of fresh accounts, but it cannot fabricate the slow accumulation of verified edges, so its accounts stay at the fringe while established agents keep the valuable work.
